title: Urate–adiposity coupling beyond sex-specific reference curves: exploratory inflammatory-state prediction across surveys
abstract: A source-centered urate × BMI product changed transported weighted Brier loss from 0.176200 to 0.176599 (delta +0.000399; approximate joint PSU bootstrap95% [-0.000001,+0.001041]); improvement was not established under the registered criterion. Exploratory independent-recruitment transfer with sex-specific conventional-measure baseline, not untouched confirmation or causal inference.
